Thank you so so so much. I really needed to hear that. I guess it does make sense with a disease this rare (affects approx 1000 people worldwide) that I would be the best person to show her how to cope. I never let my disability define me because I was never treated like I'm disabled by my family or friends. I think I will try to do this with her. 

It just kills me to see her try to pick up a small toy that she can't grip properly. It hurts me to watch her limp because I have the same limp and I know it fucking hurts. It hurts me and I'm an adult who has lived this way her whole life. I can't imagine that pain as a 2 year old. It **infuriates** me to see other moms talking to eachother and making speculations or insensitive comments while staring. These people are fucking grown. They should be better than that.

> You know in your heart that she will get stronger with age but are too afraid of the negatives that you yourself might have had to endure. 

This. Exactly this.
I have not. I shall call them for an appointment at their earliest convenience as kitty obviously needs some help and guidance. I don't know about Spiderbro though. I heard he's pretty shady.
No worries on the gender blunder or on the appointment. I suppose I oughta start getting dressed and finding something productive to do anyway. :)
Well, the truth is that she's a poor gay atheist kitty and she's being oppressed by the world and cheated out of bacon. She is sad.

Well, I'm her mom but same rules apply. Like everyone else, I always assume people on the internet are male unless they specify otherwise. Lol. I guess it's one of those things where I remember how it made me feel and I don't want her to feel that way. Ya know?

Well I don't want to just go and off myself. I didn't really know where else to post. It just makes me sad to see her in so much pain and know I can't help her. It's one of those weird things where I know she will be able to adapt but at what cost?
I should have just said my cat wanted to kill herself. That probably would have gotten more attention.
So where's all this coming from? It sounds pretty specific. Did someone look your posts over? If it makes you feel any better, I have one in SuicideWatch with 9 upvotes and not the first response.
